summary: First sweep. Facebook Marketplace was the only source that answered: tradefarmmachinery returned 403 and the Grays farm-machinery search came back empty, so auctions are unchecked this run. The saw and the ripper are the two worth acting on. The tractor is the hard one - inside 400km of Darlington Point the Marketplace stock is all compact (Kioti, 55-80hp Deere) or the right machine sitting 550km east in Gippsland.
headlines: Stihl MS 462 at Balnarring, $1,250, 63 hours, ex-government. Best find today.
Daniel Harvey 2-tyne ripper at Heathcote, $750 - right size for a 90-130hp tractor.
20ft container home at Albury, $10,999, 230km away - closest portable home in budget.
No tractor in spec: nothing 90-140hp with a loader inside 400km on Marketplace today.
Offset discs thin: one 32-plate Grizzly at $20,000, width still needs checking.

finds.title: Stihl MS 462, 63 hours, ex-government
finds.price_note: listed at $1,250; seller's text says $1,400 ono for the powerhead alone, $1,500 with a 20in or 25in bar
detail: powerhead only at the asking price, no 30in bar
finds.why: The exact saw you named, genuinely low hours, and priced low enough that a 30in bar and chain still leaves you inside budget.

finds.title: Stihl MS 460
detail: listing not opened yet - hours and condition unread
finds.why: The MS 462's predecessor and the same displacement class, so it carries a 30in bar. Cheapest way into the spec if it checks out.

finds.title: Stihl MS 661 C-M
detail: listing not opened yet - hours and condition unread
finds.why: More saw than you asked for and it pulls a 30in bar easily, but it is at the top of the budget and 15km outside your Melbourne radius.

finds.title: Daniel Harvey 2-tyne ripper, 3PL
finds.why: Two tynes is the right answer for tree roots on a 90-130hp tractor - narrow enough to pull deep without stalling. Good Australian brand at scrap-adjacent money.

finds.title: International 5-tyne ripper
detail: listing not opened yet - condition unread
finds.why: Cheap, but five tynes spreads the pull - it is a general ripper, not a root-buster. Fine as a second implement, not the one you want for tree roots.

finds.title: Grizzly 32-plate offset disc plough
detail: working width not stated - your limit is 3.5m
finds.why: Grizzly build quality is right and 32 plates is the top of your range, but a 32-plate offset is usually wider than 3.5m and needs more than 130hp. Ask for the width first.

finds.title: 20ft portable building / container home / site office
detail: listing not opened yet - bathroom and room count unconfirmed
finds.why: Closest and cheapest in the band, and Albury is an easy cart home. Confirm it actually has the bathroom before anything else.

finds.title: 13m tiny home
detail: listing not opened yet - bathroom unconfirmed
finds.why: 13m is long enough to hold two rooms and a bathroom properly rather than one room with a wet corner.

finds.title: Self-contained transportable cabin
detail: listing not opened yet - room count unconfirmed
finds.why: Self-contained usually means bathroom and kitchenette both, which is the hard part of your list. Mid-band price.

finds.title: Tiny home
detail: listing not opened yet - layout unconfirmed
finds.why: At the top of your band, so it has to be genuinely finished to be worth it over the Albury container.
